etymology.historical_story: The spelling daley illustrates why context matters in lexicography. Capitalized Daley occurs as a personal name, while a Kelantan oral-history transcript independently records daley for standard Malay dalam. These are separate identification possibilities, not evidence of shared ancestry. Without the original corpus sentence, assigning either history to this particular frequency-list item would be premature. [UiTM transcript](https://ir.uitm.edu.my/98342/2/98342.pdf), [surname reference](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/daley)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看语境再记：人名 Daley 可读作“DAY-lee”；吉兰丹转录 daley 则连到 dalam。相同字母不保证相同读音或来源。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 姓名用法尊重本人拼写和称谓；方言用法尊重说话者的地域身份，不把方言形式视为能力不足。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式马来语写作中，方言义通常换成 dalam；忠实引用访谈时可保留 daley 并附标准语对应。作为姓名时写 Daley。输入缺少原句，因此保留两种候选解释。
